## Pitch
Steer a smiley face around and make it beep.

## Rules
- R1 (auto): The stick moves the face.
- R2 (you check): The sparkles look pretty when you press A.
- R3 (auto): The face never leaves the screen.
- R4 (you check): The beep sounds happy,
  not scary.

## Controls
Stick moves. A beeps. B changes color. START clears.

## Look & sound
A yellow smiley on a dark sky.

## Assumptions
- A1: One player.
